facts.statement: The genus Homalocephale was described by Maryanska and Osmolska in 1974.
Homalocephale lived during the Late Cretaceous in the Nemegt Formation of modern-day Mongolia.
facts.quote: lived during the Late Cretaceous period of what is now the Nemegt Formation, Mongolia

facts.statement: Homalocephale reached a length of 1.8 meters.
Researchers suggest that Homalocephale was possibly an omnivore.
A 2018 study by David C. Evans and team argued that Homalocephale and Prenocephale are separate taxa because juvenile Prenocephale possessed a rounded dome, unlike the flat skull of Homalocephale.
facts.quote: David C. Evans and team in 2018 reported juvenile specimens of Prenocephale from the Nemegt Formation, noting a relatively linear growth in this pachycephalosaur characterized by a rounded dome. This differs from the flat skull of Homalocephale and given that even juvenile Prenocephale possessed a rather rounded dome, both taxa should be regarded as separate.

facts.statement: Homalocephale possessed a flat, wedge-shaped skull roof.
facts.quote: Homalocephale sported a flat, wedge-shaped skull roof

facts.statement: Homalocephale is noted for having an unusually broad pelvis.
facts.quote: Homalocephale is also noted for having an unusually broad pelvis

facts.statement: It is debated whether the broad pelvis of Homalocephale served to protect vital organs during flank-butting or facilitated the birth of live young.
facts.quote: some have suggested that the width served to protect vital organs from harm during flank-butting. Others think that they were for giving birth to live young, instead of laying eggs

facts.statement: Homalocephale lived at the end of the Cretaceous, approximately 80 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
facts.quote: vivió a finales del Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 80 millones de años, en el Campaniense

facts.statement: Homalocephale was a bipedal, fast-running herbivore that lived in herds.
facts.quote: Era un herbívoro bípedo corredor que vivía en manadas

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that Homalocephale's wide, thick skull may have been used in mating rituals.
facts.quote: Su cráneo, ancho y grueso, pudo emplearse en rituales de apareamiento

facts.statement: It is debated whether Homalocephale is a synonym or a juvenile form of Prenocephale.
facts.quote: aunque este puede ser un sinónimo y una forma juvenil de Prenocephale

facts.statement: Homalocephale is classified as a homalocephaloid pachycephalosaurian dinosaur.
The time range for Homalocephale is the Maastrichtian, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Homalocephale belongs to the parent group Eupachycephalosauria.
